title: An exact Delaunay flux identity for compact equilibria in the liquid drop model
summary: We revisit the construction of compact liquid drop equilibria from Delaunay unduloids in [Arch. Ration. Mech. Anal. 249 (2025), Paper No. 74]. We evaluate exactly the coefficient arising in the final solvability condition of the Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction, identifying it as the product of the axial period and the normalised Delaunay flux. Using this identity and the monotonicity of the period, we establish the conjectured positivity of the coefficient and prove that its product with the period strictly increases with the neck radius.
